name: Reaction Engineering for Environment and Sustainability
description: Sustainable catalytic reaction engineering in industrial processes. Environmental impact. Reaction mechanisms. Kinetics of solid-catalyzed reactions. Microkinetic modeling for clean air technology. External and internal mass transfer effects. Packed-bed reactor design. Falsified kinetics and mass transfer limitations. Laboratory reactors: design and transport limitations. Sustainable design of commercial reactors. Environmental catalysis: air pollution control. Case studies: hydrogen generation, CO₂ valorization, non-catalytic gas-solid reactions.
